description: Fork of exp567 (E=96, 1.4768 @ 103.02M). ONLY change: qkv_lut TinyMHLut -> SoftAnchorPairMHLUT (directed-gradient soft anchor pairs). Other 3 LUT modules (v_lut, out_proj, residual_lut) keep TinyMHLut. anchor_tau cosine-anneal 1.0 -> 0.001 over steps 0-3000, then set qk_lut.hard=True for exact argmax forward through step 8000. anchor_logits routed to separate AdamW group (lr=anchor_lr), LUT weights still on Lion. Tests whether learning anchor coordinate pairs (vs random fixed anchors) recovers the 16x random combinatorial sparsity at E=96/NAP=6 — the most likely cause of the modest exp567 gain. Refs: exp567 1.4768 (this fork's parent), exp513 1.4825 (E=64 base), exp562 1.4714 (D=512 alt path), vanilla exp328 1.3882. Adjudicate vs exp567: any sub-1.4768 with no >0.01 bpb blip at step ~3000-3200 = mechanism works (broaden in exp569 to v/residual). Watch L*.qk_lut.anchor_tau in temperatures.csv for the snap, and check anchor_logits.argmax diversity post-run.
